items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Bing Crosby had to have some kind of influence on Sinatra.

ctx.x: But, it's like -- it sounds to me sometimes as though Bing Crosby had an effect on the way guys sang in the '30s.

Well, certainly. He had an effect on Sinatra, all of them. He was before Sinatra. But as music went, the style of playing and the style of sounds like years ago, you had the honky tonk travelling music. And then it went into swing and then it went into -- I mean, it went into Dixieland, and then from Dixieland it went into swing. And then it went into bebop. And it's just changed.
Like, you were talking about singers. Now, I -- Bing Crosby had to have some kind of influence on Sinatra.
